title:
Comment of Margaret Madden in Docket(s)/Project(s) P-15423-000
Submission Date: 10/23/2026

documents.name: 151815.txt
documents.text:
Margaret Madden, Anchorage, AK.
Most Alaskans don't want data centers.  They hurt the environment.  An under water data center will harm the endangered Cook Inlet beluga whales.  I am completely against the idea of a data center being built in the Cook Inlet.  Please listen to the people that actually live in Alaska.
